fields.label: Description
fields.older:
You <rt.absorb>Start each Dungeon</> with <rt.mana>50 Spirit Points</>.

Your <rt.absorb>Culling Strike</> generates <rt.mana>1 Spirit Point</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older: When you activate <rt.absorb>Stone Shield</> you take <rt.bold>10% reduced damage</> for 8 seconds.
fields.newer: When you activate <rt.absorb>Stone Shield</> you take <rt.bold>20% reduced damage</> for 8 seconds.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
You <rt.absorb>Start each Dungeon</> with <rt.mana>50 Spirit Points</>.

Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Gust</> you release a burst of winds at your starting location, causing all enemies within 750 radius to have <rt.effect>50% reduced movement speed</> for 6 seconds.
fields.newer: Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Gust</> you release a burst of winds at your starting location, causing all enemies within 750 radius to have <rt.effect>50% reduced movement speed</> for 6 seconds.

fields.label: Description
fields.older: Your <rt.absorb>Serenity</> applies <rt.effect>Peacefield</> on you, healing you for <rt.heal>45% of the initial heal's value over 9 seconds</>.
fields.newer: Your <rt.absorb>Serenity</> applies <rt.effect>Peacefield</> on you, healing you for <rt.heal>80% of the initial heal's value over 9 seconds</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Each time you generate <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</>, you have a <rt.bold>20% chance</> to gain  <rt.effect>Frostweaver's Wrath</> for <rt.bold>12 seconds</>, causing the next <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> or <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> that deals damage to have <rt.warning>100% additional critical strike chance</>.

<rt.warning>GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE</>
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a <rt.warning>grievous critical strike</>. <rt.warning>Grievous critical strikes</> increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.
fields.newer:
Each time you generate <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</>, you have a <rt.bold>20% chance</> to gain  <rt.effect>Frostweaver's Wrath</> for <rt.bold>20 seconds</>, causing the next <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> or <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> that deals damage to have <rt.warning>100% additional critical strike chance</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
When your <rt.absorb>Frost Bolt</> deals damage to an enemy, it triggers a single pulse of <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</>.

Your <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> deals <rt.warning>20% more damage</>.

Your <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> deals <rt.warning>30% more damage</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Each time you cast an ability you have a chance to gain <rt.effect>Soulfrost Torrent</> for <rt.bold>18 seconds</>, causing your next <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> to have <rt.warning>40% increased tick rate</> and <rt.warning>+100% increased critical strike chance</>. (1.2 PPM)

<rt.warning>GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE</>

fields.label: Description

fields.newer: When your <rt.mana>Toughness</> has reduced an amount of damage equal to <rt.bold>30% of your Maximum Health</>, you gain <rt.effect>20% increased Strength</> for 14 sec.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
The first hit of your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> triggers explosion of metal, <rt.warning>dealing damage equal to 40% of the hit that triggered it</> to the target and up to 7 additional nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>Razor Shrapnel</> applies <rt.effect>Agonizing Wound</> to targets, reducing the damage they deal to you by 20% for 5 seconds.
fields.newer:
The first hit of your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> triggers explosion of metal, <rt.warning>dealing damage equal to 40% of the hit that triggered it</> to the target and up to 11 additional nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>Razor Shrapnel</> applies <rt.effect>Agonizing Wound</> to targets, reducing the damage they deal to you by 20% for 5 seconds.

fields.label: Description
fields.older: The <rt.bold>absorb shield</> from your <rt.effect>Empowered Shield Slams</> takes <rt.bold>20% reduced damage</> & enemies that attack you while it is active take <rt.warning>50% Strength</> physical damage.
fields.newer: The <rt.bold>absorb shield</> from your <rt.effect>Empowered Shield Slams</> takes <rt.bold>20% reduced damage</> & enemies that attack you while it is active take <rt.warning>100% Strength</> physical damage.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Each tick of your <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> grants you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</> for 15 seconds, up to 30 stacks.

Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> consumes all stacks of <rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</>, increasing its damage by <rt.warning>30%</> per stack. Additionally, your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> hits <rt.bold>1 additional enemy</> near your target for each stack it consumes.

<rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</> damage is reduced beyond 3 targets.
fields.newer:
Each tick of your <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> grants you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</> for 15 seconds, up to 30 stacks, and you can now move while channeling.

Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> consumes all stacks of <rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</>, increasing its damage by <rt.warning>30%</> per stack. Additionally, your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> hits <rt.bold>1 additional enemy</> near your target for each stack it consumes.

<rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</> damage is reduced beyond 3 targets.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Your <rt.absorb>Winter's Blessing</> grants you <rt.bold>2 stacks</> of <rt.effect>Undulating Spirits</>.

Your next ability that spends <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> consumes 1 stack of <rt.effect>Undulating Spirits</> and always triggers a <rt.mana>Spirit Refund</>.

You start each dungeon with <rt.mana>50 Spirit Points</>.
fields.newer:
Your <rt.absorb>Winter's Blessing</> grants you <rt.bold>2 stacks</> of <rt.effect>Undulating Spirits</>.

Your next ability that spends <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> consumes 1 stack of <rt.effect>Undulating Spirits</> and always triggers a <rt.mana>Spirit Refund</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
While <rt.absorb>Fleeting Hour</> is active on you, <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> is empowered.

When targeting an enemy, <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> deals <rt.warning>50% more damage to your primary target</> and causes <rt.warning>additional bolts to hit up to 2 enemies near the target for 40% of the power</>.

When targeting an ally, each bolt of <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> <rt.heal>cleanses the target of 3% Stagger</>.
fields.newer:
While <rt.absorb>Fleeting Hour</> is active on you, <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> is empowered.

When targeting an enemy, <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> deals <rt.warning>80% more damage to your primary target</> and causes <rt.warning>additional bolts to hit up to 2 enemies near the target for 50% of the power</>.

When targeting an ally, each bolt of <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> <rt.heal>cleanses the target of 3% Stagger</>.

Your next <rt.Absorb>Heavy Strike</> consumes <rt.bold>1 stack</> of <rt.effect>Kill Em All</>, causing it to deal <rt.warning>150% more damage</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> grants you <rt.bold>1 stack</> of <rt.effect>Square Hammer</> for 20 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

Your next <rt.absorb>Skull Crusher</> or <rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> consumes all stacks, reducing the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Thunder Call</> by <rt.bold>1 second per stack</>.

Each time you consume <rt.effect>Square Hammer</> you are granted <rt.warning>+5% Expertise</> for <rt.bold>4 seconds</>.
fields.newer:
Your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> grants you <rt.bold>1 stack</> of <rt.effect>Square Hammer</> for 20 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

Your next <rt.absorb>Skull Crusher</> or <rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> consumes all stacks, reducing the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Thunder Call</> by <rt.bold>1 second per stack</>.

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Apply a shield to target ally that absorbs up to <rt.heal>{LuminousAbsorb}</> damage. <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> lasts for up to <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

Damage absorbed by <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> is <rt.heal>reduced by {LuminousDmgRed}</>.

<rt.effect>RESIDUAL LUMINOSITY</>
When <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> expires or is removed from a player, they gain <rt.effect>Residual Luminosity</> for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>, <rt.heal>reducing all damage taken by 15%</>.

<rt.effect>GRAND DESIGN</>
<rt.bold>Hold down the ability button</> until a cast bar is displayed to cast this ability on up to 4 targets at 60% power. Requires <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</>. 

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a rune of protection onto an ally, causing light to be woven around them into a barrier of divine energy. The barrier stops all forms of attack, whether forged by steel or conjured by magic.</>

fields.label: Description
fields.older:
Elheryn, the Pathfinder, guides you through the dungeon.

By defeating all highlighted enemies you will reach the required Kill Score and be led to the boss.

<bold>BONUS</>
While in combat with enemies marked with Pathfinder's Guidance, you gain Haste.
Contender: +20% Haste
Adept: +15% Haste
Champion: +10% Haste
Paragon: +5% Haste
fields.newer:
Elheryn, the Pathfinder, guides you through the dungeon.

By defeating all highlighted enemies you will reach the required Kill Score and be led to the boss.

<bold>BONUS</>
While in combat with enemies marked with Pathfinder's Guidance, you gain up to {HasteValue} Haste depending on your average item level. A higher average item level leads to lower haste.
